publication.reason: Archived turret print estimates and files predate the current mechanical changes and lack current source receipts. No complete turret print kit has been regenerated or qualified.

pan_base.how: PA6-CF on its foot; 4 x M5 x 16 into the head ring, 2 x Ø5 dowels

base_board_carrier.how: Removable board carrier; exterior face on bed, standoffs up; service requires bumper removal

pan_ring.how: PA6-CF upside down; DIN 471-50 circlip; 4 x M4 inserts

pan_spacer.how: PA6-CF on its wide end; between the 61810 inner race and the circlip

pan_pinion.how: PA6-CF; 4 x M2 to the horn; turns -3 x pan about the servo axis

tilt_yoke.how: PA6-CF on its back; 4 x M4 x 12 to the turntable (heads 6 mm down in the 12 mm bridge)

cradle.how: PA6-CF flat, no supports: the rail frame (D48); 8 x M3 inserts for the aluminium cheek plates

horn_boss.how: PA6-CF on an end face; between the +y plate and the tilt servo's horn (4 x M3 x 14 flat heads)

pivot_spacer.how: PA6-CF on its boss face, land up; between the -y plate and the MR126 (the shoulder screw through it)

cartridge_body.how: PA6-CF on its base; supports under the chute

flywheel.how: PA6-CF on its top face; on the X2216's prop adapter: washer + M5 nylon-insert nut; bore reamed to 5.00

dial.how: PETG; 4 x M3 x 8 down into the feed servo's horn, from the top

hopper.how: translucent PETG standing; 3 x M3 to the housing; three ridges for the lid's latches, the notch for its key

hopper_lid.how: PETG upside down (the latches in the bed plane), on the flap's hinge lugs and the latches: supports under the disc only; three snap latches onto the hopper's ridges, push on, pull off; keyed, goes on one way

barrel.how: PETG standing; last 15 mm blaze orange

laser_mount.how: PETG; 3 x M3 boresight, 2 x M3 x 10 to the socket pad

ring_carrier.how: PA6-CF on its top face; 3 x M3 x 10 flat heads up into the base; 3 x M3 inserts for the ring

ring_driver.how: PA6-CF on its top face; in the turntable's bore (ribs + CA)

board_bay.how: PETG on its back; 4 x M3 x 8 flat heads to the -y yoke arm; 4 x M3 inserts for the boards; two ridges for the lid's latches

board_bay_lid.how: PETG flat (the latches in the bed plane); two snap latches onto the bay's ridges, push on, pull off

stand_box.how: printed PETG upside down; 4 x M5 + 4 x M3 inserts for the bottom, 2 x M3 x 4.3 (94459A130) for the dock (set with a flat tip, the top face on a flat plate, then check the pan base's seat flat; the dock adapter's M3s no longer than its base + 5 mm: 0.7 mm of plate over the pilots), 4 x M3 for the board

stand_bottom.how: printed PETG flat; 4 x M3 x 8 into the corner bosses; 4 rubber feet; two ribs the pack slides on

note: the bench turret (cad/turret.py, v0: no bumper, no fill flap) and its stand; grams and hours are Bambu Studio's where the part is sliced (sliced: true, cad/turret_print.py), rough otherwise
